caption:
I always look for the transition points when designing mountain biking in Costa Rica—where the gravel roads narrow and the forest canopy closes in. These backroads require a quiet focus; the dirt is damp, the climbs are steep, and the green is absolute. Every route we run at My Adventure Costa Rica is one I have personally scouted, pedal stroke by pedal stroke, to find this exact balance of physical effort and deep-country solitude. Share this with the person you would ride these hills with.
